h: The Third Meal Brings Favor That Breaks the Bonds of Impurity

p: "Outside they remain and do not enter,
In the holy Zohar (Zohar Chadash on this parsha):
a woman who has relations with a gentile
is bound to him like a dog;
And in the Gemara this expression occurs
regarding one who has relations with a gentile woman,
that she is bound to him like a dog
as referring to the World to Come.
And regarding a woman who has relations with a gentile
that he casts impurity into her
and it says that a woman who has relations with an uncircumcised man
"You had the brow of a harlot;
And at the third meal of Shabbos,
when it is the Will of Wills,
then the time is propitious for rectification
Although it says in the Gemara (Eruvin 19a):
who had relations with a gentile woman,
and he does not recognize him"
she is bound to him like a dog,
which is "the brow of a harlot."
And so we find in the Gemara (Yevamos 60b):
any whose face turned pale," etc.;
but for the nations of the world,
the opposite of "the brow of a harlot,"
with the revelation of the Forehead of Atika,
the forehead of the kelipah is nullified,
and she is not bound to him like a dog,
and then Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
and brings him up from Gehinnom.

paragraphs.text: Source: Avodah Zarah 5a — “רבי אלעזר אומר: קשורה בו ככלב, שנאמר: ״ולא שמע אליה לשכב אצלה להיות עמה״, ״לשכב אצלה״ — בעולם הזה, ״להיות עמה״ — בעולם הבא.” (Oz Vehadar print, p. 20) — “Rabbi Elazar says: The transgression is tied to him like a dog and does not leave him, as it is stated with regard to Joseph and Potiphar’s wife: “And he did not listen to her, to lie by her, or to be with her” (Genesis 39:10). This teaches that Joseph refused “to lie by her” in this world, which would have meant that he would have had “to be with her” in the World-to-Come.”

p: And this is the matter of the war against Midian,
in which they were commanded to execute Hashem's vengeance on Midian;
that one who causes another to sin
is worse than one who kills him
and the taking of the spoils,
whose number is written in the Torah in detail
the number of half the booty
and the number of the Children of Israel's half in detail;
yet the levy is not detailed
and why is all this written?
and in the Torah there is not a single superfluous letter!
And the Ramban, of blessed memory,
that from the day it was taken
until the levy was set aside,
that one of five hundred was set aside
and not one of them died.
for the greatness of the miracle,
that there was so great a quantity
but afterward, why is it detailed?
But the matter of the war
is of the secret of Hashem:
that the dealing with the booty they took
the aspect of their power and life;
for in all of them there are sparks of holiness,
"And You give life to them all";
along the lines of how we explain
the spoil of Egypt, the "great wealth,"
and the spoil at the Sea,
that it is the sparks of holiness
they were commanded regarding the war
that is, their spirit of life;
which is the kelipah of the serpent, the harlot
there was a rectification for those who sinned
And this is what we say:
"And behold, the Ancient of Days has invited
And although on Shabbos Gehinnom rests,
"From the work of His world He rested,
from the work of the wicked," etc.;
that the punishment of the wicked
after all, the wicked are not judged
so what is it that it writes,
that He shows these and those
a sample of what is reserved for them?
the place of Gehinnom and the kelipah;
in hunger, in weeping, in mourning,
the kelipah of the serpent, the harlot,
the Woman of Valor, her mistress:
so the serpent, the harlot, goes
after the secret of the Woman of Valor"
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב קמח, ב)
"and they will be hidden among the rocks."
"And it shall be that from new moon to new moon
and from Shabbos to Shabbos," etc.;
"and they shall go out and look
upon the corpses of the men
even for the transgressors of the nations of the world,
as they said in the Gemara (Sanhedrin 65b):
And here it is impossible to explain it
"the corpses of the men who rebelled."
of the time of the Resurrection of the Dead,
"And many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake,
And so it is written here,
"And they shall be an abhorrence to all flesh";
and it says that then Titus and the like will come to life,
those who acted wickedly to do evil
"And they shall go out and look
upon the corpses of the men who rebelled against Me"
which refers to the transgressors of the nations of the world,
and then there will be no Gehinnom at all,
but rather, along the lines of what they said
but a fire that comes forth
from the bodies of the wicked
שֶׁזֶּה הָאֵשׁ שֶׁל הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע שֶׁלָּהֶם
that this is the fire of their yetzer hara,
(this was explained in Parshas Vayeira, maamar 1).
And this is what it says:
"For their fire shall not be quenched."
וְהוּא עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (סַנְהֶדְרִין ק, ב)
And this is according to what they said (Sanhedrin 100b):
when a person puts his finger into fire,
And this is what it says:
"For their fire shall not be quenched"
that the fire of their yetzer hara
for Hashem Yisbarach will give them strength,
and the worm will consume them,
and their fire will not be quenched;
"and they shall be an abhorrence to all flesh."
And this is the meaning of
what they said in the Midrash Rabbah
"This teaches that HaKadosh Baruch Hu showed
"'I have shown it to you with your eyes' (Devarim 34:4)
this teaches that He showed him Gehinnom.
And who are judged in it?
The wicked and those who rebel against Me," etc.;
"Moshe began to be afraid of Gehinnom.
I have shown it to you with your eyes,
but there you shall not cross over."
And in truth, also before this,
it is written in Parshas Ha'azinu (Devarim 32:52):
"For from afar you shall see the land,
but there you shall not come," etc.;
and there it is not expounded about Gehinnom.
אַךְ בְּפָרָשַׁת בְּרָכָה כְּתִיב (שָׁם לד, א-ב)
But in Parshas Berachah it is written (Devarim 34:1–2):
and it is expounded (in the Sifrei, Berachah):
this teaches that He showed him
from the day it was created
until the day the dead come to life."
"And they shall go out and look
upon the corpses of the men who rebelled against Me,"
"The wicked and those who rebel against Me";
and He did not tell him
that it is only the transgressors of the nations of the world,
to the transgressors and wicked of Yisrael,
And this is what it says:
"Moshe began to be afraid of Gehinnom"
that he would need to enter there
along the lines of what they said
about Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
"If I take him by the hand,
who will snatch him from me?"
that he will go down and bring him up by his hand.
And so the Arizal, of blessed memory, wrote,
even at the time he broke the Luchos,
that they be judged as an unmarried woman;
"And they are Your people and Your inheritance";
that he would need to go down to Gehinnom
to raise up the transgressors of Yisrael.
And this is what it says,
that Moshe was afraid of Gehinnom;
and about this Hashem Yisbarach said,
"but there you shall not cross over";
are the transgressors of the nations of the world,
who even at the very entrance of Gehinnom
accept the justice of the judgment upon themselves,
and shed tears like a spring,
and extinguish the fire of Gehinnom,
with the holiness of Gan Eden,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַב הָרַמָ״ע מִפָּאנוֹ זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה
as the Rama of Pano, of blessed memory, wrote.
took place on Shabbos at this hour,
before Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב קנו, א)
and then Hashem Yisbarach told him:
"And they shall go out and look
upon the corpses of the men," etc.,
And this is what we say at this meal:
"Outside they remain and do not enter,
that with the revelation of the Forehead of Atika
the kelipah of the serpent, the harlot,
"He will place them in their holes"
that they descend into the hole
"and they will be hidden among the rocks":
and the whole kelipah will be nullified,
and each one of Yisrael merits
"to see the radiance of Z'eir Anpin."
